parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: Reduce, reuse, recycle

options.label: Reduce: use less. Take a cloth bag to the shop.
Reuse: use it again. Fill your water bottle again and again.
Recycle: break it down and make something new. Old bottles can become a jumper!

steps.explanation: Three R words help our planet: reduce, reuse and recycle.
steps.shortExplanation: Three R words help our planet: reduce, reuse and recycle.

steps.title: Helpers in an information book

options.label: The heading at the top tells us what the page is about.
A caption is a sentence under a picture that tells us about it.
A label is one or two words with a line pointing to something.

steps.explanation: An information book tells true facts, with headings, captions and labels to help us.
steps.shortExplanation: An information book tells true facts, with headings, captions and labels to help us.

steps.title: The three Rs
steps.prompt: Match each word to what it means.

targets.label: break it down and make something new

steps.hint: Reuse has use in it: use it again.
steps.explanation: Reduce is use less, reuse is use it again, recycle is make it into something new.
steps.shortExplanation: Reduce is use less, reuse is use it again, recycle is make it into something new.

source.answerKeyText: Reduce – use less, buy fewer things • Reuse – use the same thing again • Recycle – break it down and make something new

steps.title: Under the picture
steps.prompt: A sentence under a picture that tells us about it is called a…
steps.hint: Look at the outlined part of the page.
steps.explanation: A caption is a sentence under a picture.
steps.shortExplanation: A caption is a sentence under a picture.

steps.title: The blurb
steps.prompt: Where do we find the blurb?

options.label: on the first page of the story

steps.explanation: The blurb is on the back cover. It tells us what the book is about.
steps.shortExplanation: The blurb is on the back cover. It tells us what the book is about.

steps.title: The contents page
steps.prompt: What do we use a contents page for?

options.label: to find which page to go to

steps.hint: It is near the start and has page numbers.
steps.explanation: A contents page shows what is inside and which page to go to.
steps.shortExplanation: A contents page shows what is inside and which page to go to.

source.answerKeyText: To find where things are in the book / which page to go to.

steps.title: Reduce, reuse or recycle?
steps.prompt: Is each one reduce, reuse or recycle?

options.label: Filling your water bottle again and again.
Putting cans in the recycling bin.

steps.hint: Using the same thing again is reuse. Using less is reduce.
steps.explanation: Refilling a bottle is reuse, the recycling bin is recycle, fewer bags is reduce.
steps.shortExplanation: Refilling a bottle is reuse, the recycling bin is recycle, fewer bags is reduce.

source.answerKeyText: a reuse • b recycle • c reduce

steps.title: Plastic in the sea
steps.prompt: Why is a plastic bag dangerous for a turtle?

options.label: The turtle can think it is food and eat it.
Turtles like to play with bags.

steps.hint: What does a floating bag look like to a turtle?
steps.explanation: A plastic bag looks like food, so a turtle can eat it or get tangled.
steps.shortExplanation: A plastic bag looks like food, so a turtle can eat it or get tangled.

source.answerKeyText: It can eat it because it looks like food, or get tangled in it.

steps.title: True or false?
steps.prompt: Is each sentence true or false?

options.label: An information book tells true facts.
A label is usually a long story.

steps.explanation: An information book tells true facts. A label is only one or two words.
steps.shortExplanation: An information book tells true facts. A label is only one or two words.

source.answerKeyText: a T • b F — a label is one or two words.

steps.title: A good label
steps.prompt: Which one is a good label for a picture of a pencil pot?

options.label: I made this pencil pot from an old bottle, and it holds all my pencils.

steps.hint: A label is tiny: one or two words.
steps.explanation: Pencil pot is a good label: just two words. The long sentence is a caption.
steps.shortExplanation: Pencil pot is a good label: just two words. The long sentence is a caption.

source.answerKeyText: A drawing of something made from a bottle (pencil pot, plant pot, bird feeder…), a short label (one or two words with a line) and a caption sentence underneath.

steps.title: An information book
steps.hint: Story books are made up. Information books are…?
steps.explanation: An information book tells us true facts about the world.
steps.shortExplanation: An information book tells us true facts about the world.

steps.title: A caption
steps.explanation: A caption is a sentence about a picture.
steps.shortExplanation: A caption is a sentence about a picture.

steps.title: A can in the bin
steps.prompt: Putting a can in the recycling bin is…
steps.hint: The can will be broken down and made into something new.
steps.explanation: Putting a can in the recycling bin is recycling.
steps.shortExplanation: Putting a can in the recycling bin is recycling.

steps.title: Where is the blurb?
steps.explanation: The blurb is on the back cover.
steps.shortExplanation: The blurb is on the back cover.

steps.title: A label
steps.hint: Labels are tiny, with a line pointing.
steps.explanation: A label is usually one or two words.
steps.shortExplanation: A label is usually one or two words.

stickers.meaning: Break a thing down and make something new.

goalActivities.text: Turn an old plastic bottle into a pencil pot together (you do the cutting) and say: we reused it!
goalActivities.textAr: حوّلوا إزازة بلاستيك قديمة لمقلمة مع بعض (انت اللي تقص)، وقولوا: we reused it!
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Look at a newspaper or a magazine together and find a picture with a caption. Read the caption aloud.
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا على جرنال أو مجلة مع بعض ولاقوا صورة تحتها تعليق، واقروا التعليق بصوت عالي.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Take a book or a cereal box off the shelf. Your child finds the title on the front and the blurb on the back.
goalActivities.textAr: خدوا كتاب أو علبة كورن فليكس من الرف، وطفلك يلاقي العنوان قدام والنبذة ورا.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Use the contents page of an information book together to jump straight to one page. Ask: why is it useful?
goalActivities.textAr: استعملوا صفحة الفهرس في كتاب معلومات مع بعض عشان تروحوا لصفحة على طول. واسألوا: مفيدة ليه؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Go round the house and find one way to reduce, one way to reuse and one thing to recycle.
goalActivities.textAr: لفّوا في البيت ولاقوا طريقة نقلّل بيها، وطريقة نستعمل بيها حاجة تاني، وحاجة نعيد تدويرها.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Look at a picture of a sea turtle together. Talk about what you can do with plastic bags so they never reach the sea.
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا على صورة سلحفاة بحرية مع بعض، واتكلموا ممكن تعملوا إيه بالأكياس البلاستيك عشان متوصلش للبحر أبدًا.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Play true or false with facts about animals: a cat has four legs (true), a fish can fly (false).
goalActivities.textAr: العبوا صح ولا غلط بمعلومات عن الحيوانات: القطة ليها أربع رجلين (صح)، السمكة بتطير (غلط).
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Fold two sheets of paper into a mini information book about your kitchen. Each page gets a heading, a drawing with labels and a caption.
goalActivities.textAr: اطبقوا ورقتين واعملوا كتاب معلومات صغير عن المطبخ. كل صفحة فيها عنوان، ورسمة عليها أسامي، وتعليق تحتها.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: At the library or bookshop, find one story book and one information book. How can you tell them apart?
goalActivities.textAr: في المكتبة لاقوا كتاب قصة وكتاب معلومات. تفرّقوا بينهم إزاي؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Print or draw a family photo and write a caption under it together: Our trip to the beach.
goalActivities.textAr: اطبعوا أو ارسموا صورة للعيلة واكتبوا تعليق تحتها مع بعض: Our trip to the beach.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Wash an empty can together and put it in the recycling. Talk about what it could become.
goalActivities.textAr: اغسلوا علبة فاضية مع بعض وحطوها في إعادة التدوير، واتكلموا ممكن تبقى إيه.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Read the blurb of a new book before you start it. Ask: does it make you want to read the book?
goalActivities.textAr: اقروا نبذة كتاب جديد قبل ما تبدأوه، واسألوا: خلّتك عايز تقرا الكتاب؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Draw a picture of your pet or a toy and add labels with lines: ear, tail, eye.
goalActivities.textAr: ارسموا صورة لحيوانكم الأليف أو لعبة، وحطّوا أسامي بخطوط: ear و tail و eye.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

homeActivities.text: Sort clean rubbish together into paper, metal, plastic and food. Before each one, ask: which pile do you think? What could we reuse instead?
homeActivities.textAr: قسّموا زبالة نضيفة مع بعض: ورق، معدن، بلاستيك، أكل. قبل كل حاجة اسألوا: تفتكر تروح أنهي كومة؟ وإيه اللي ممكن نستعمله تاني بدل ما نرميه؟
